semesters.title: First Semester
semesters.description: First semester in B.Sc. CSIT helps to create the fundamental foundation of technology, electronic circuits, programming, and arithmetic to urge you started with the journey of B.Sc. CSIT.

chapters.title: Combinational Logic With Msi And Lsi
Universal Gates And Physics Of Integrated Circuits

semesters.title: Second Semester
semesters.description: The second semester of B.Sc. CSIT focuses on elementary ideas of object-oriented programming approach, problem-solving, and advanced ideas of electronic circuits and boards.

chapters.title: Virtual Function Polymorphism And Miscellaneous C Features
Basic I O Memory R W And Interrupt Operations

semesters.title: Third Semester
semesters.description: The third semester of B.Sc. CSIT focuses on the foundation of information structures, mathematical modeling, the design of computers, ideas of graphics, and applied mathematics measures together with hypotheses and varied tests.

chapters.title: Illumination Models And Surface Rendering Technique

semesters.title: Fourth Semester
semesters.description: Fourth semester of B.Sc. CSIT introduces state machines and their languages, the conception of the pc networks and operating systems, the inspiration of the database management system and a glimpse of underlying principles of artificial intelligence.

chapters.title: Introduction To Transaction Processing Concepts And Theory
The Relational Algebra And Relational Calculus
The Relational Data Model And Relational Database Constraints

semesters.title: Fifth Semester
semesters.description: Fifth semester of B.Sc. CSIT is an introduction to basic components of design and analysis of pc algorithms, software development cycle, underlying principles and design of cryptosystems, modeling and simulation of various kinds of systems, elementary ideas of web development, multimedia, and image processing.
